repositoryVariables.ROSEOS_BUILDER_RUNNER_READY: 'true' only after the repository-scoped runner labelled roseos-frankel-builder is registered on immortal-os-builder
repositoryVariables.GCP_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER: Full resource name of the GitHub OIDC provider restricted to this repository, main and os-release.yml
repositoryVariables.GCP_CONTROLLER_SERVICE_ACCOUNT: Identity limited to get/start/stop of immortal-os-builder
repositoryVariables.GCP_SIGNER_SERVICE_ACCOUNT: Identity limited to reading the six existing signing secrets
repositoryVariables.PIXEL_OTA_PUBLISHER: Publisher credential mechanism; unset until the publisher credential decision is made

bootstrap.repositorySecrets: Depend on the chosen publisher mechanism; none are read until PIXEL_OTA_PUBLISHER names a supported one

hostInputs.host.integrateCommand: Lead-managed builder entry point that reconciles the candidate into the retained tree and writes $ROSE_RELEASE_DIR/background-policy.json
hostInputs.host.signCommand: Lead-managed builder entry point that signs with the existing identities and writes $ROSE_RELEASE_DIR/signed-target_files.zip and $ROSE_RELEASE_DIR/public/
